items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: I was learning a bass at that time with, uh, Billy Moreira.

ctx.x: Well, I tell you, I was learning a bass at that time with, uh, Billy Moreira. And, uh, George played a banquet somewhere. I don't know where he played. I think it was at the Copper Raiders Hall. And, uh, Billy told George that, uh, I was, uh, learning bass on the hymn. So, George said, well, I know Chester Good. He knew all my brothers and everything, you know? So, that's where, he said, well, that's good. Chester said, keep up the good work. Just like that. So, I said, I'm a try. And I just kept on playing and…
